pts=None
last=None

def control(o):
 global pts,last,logged
 t=o['t']; h=o['hitch_deg']; th=math.radians(-h)

  c=math.cos(da); s=math.sin(da)
  pts=[(c*(x-v*dt)+s*y,-s*(x-v*dt)+c*y) for x,y in pts]

  pp=[(ox+d*math.cos(math.radians(b)),oy+d*math.sin(math.radians(b))) for b,d in cam['target_corners']]
  pp.sort(key=lambda p:-(p[0]*math.cos(th)+p[1]*math.sin(th)))
  near=((pp[0][0]+pp[1][0])/2,(pp[0][1]+pp[1][1])/2)
  far=((pp[2][0]+pp[3][0])/2,(pp[2][1]+pp[3][1])/2)

 if pts is None:

 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; c=math.cos(th); s=math.sin(th)
 local=[]

  logged=True; print('Final approach',local,'hitch',h); wake('Final approach')
 return (steer,-0.45,-23)

    h=o['hitch_deg']; r=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; pts=[]

        ox,oy=v['origin']

            if r[0]-7<x<r[0]+3 and y>r[1]+1.1:
                pts.append((x,y))
    desired=0
    if len(pts)>=4:
        xm=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); ym=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)

import math
centre=0.0
last=0.0
n=0
def control(o):
 global centre,last,n
 n+=1
 h=o['hitch_deg']; th=math.radians(-h)
 cam=o['views'].get('camera'); look=7.0
 if cam:
  sides=[[],[]]
  for b,d in cam['walls']:
   b=math.radians(b); dx=d*math.cos(b); dy=d*math.sin(b)
   s=-dx*math.cos(th)-dy*math.sin(th); y=-dx*math.sin(th)+dy*math.cos(th)
   if 2<s<14 and abs(y)>1.5:
    sides[0 if y<0 else 1].append((s,y))
  vals=[]
  for pts in sides:
   if len(pts)<2: break
   weights=[math.exp(-((s-look)/3.5)**2) for s,y in pts]
   sw=sum(weights); sx=sum(w*s for w,(s,y) in zip(weights,pts))/sw; sy=sum(w*y for w,(s,y) in zip(weights,pts))/sw
   den=sum(w*(s-sx)**2 for w,(s,y) in zip(weights,pts))
   slope=sum(w*(s-sx)*(y-sy) for w,(s,y) in zip(weights,pts))/max(den,0.01)
   vals.append(sy+slope*(look-sx))
  if len(vals)==2:
   raw=sum(vals)/2
   centre+=0.12*(raw-centre)
 target=math.degrees(math.atan(20.4*centre/(look*look)))
 target=max(-38,min(38,target))
 steer=math.degrees(math.atan(3.9/10.2*math.sin(math.radians(h))))+1.5*(h-target)
